From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. Responsibilities: Po sition Purpose: Global Talent Acquisition (TA) Operations keeps StoneX's hiring engine running — including the applicant tracking system (iCIMS), hiring data, compliance controls, the agency program, and the processes that recruiters, hiring managers, and HR partners rely on every day. As Senior Specialist, you will serve as TA Operations' owner for the APAC time zone, working alongside a US-based Lead to provide the team with round-the-clock coverage and faster issue resolution. You will own several core processes end to end, run day-to-day iCIMS administration, and help shape how StoneX applies automation and AI across recruiting in a compliant, scalable way. Help design, test, and roll out AI agents and automations — including job-description review, TA knowledge, and requisition validation agents — and track adoption and results. Work with Legal, Privacy, and Compliance to ensure AI and automated tools used in hiring meet applicable laws and internal policy, covering bias-audit, transparency, candidate-notice, and data-protection requirements across jurisdictions (for example, NYC Local Law 144, the EU AI Act, GDPR, and India's DPDP Act). Maintain an inventory of AI and automation tools used in recruiting, including their purpose, data used, human-review points, and compliance status. Roll new tools out to the global TA team, build training materials, run training sessions, and drive adoption. Act as ongoing system owner and vendor contact for recruiting tools, and keep integrations with iCIMS healthy. Serve as first point of contact for recruiters, coordinators, HRBPs, and HR Operations on iCIMS and process questions; resolve issues. Maintain dashboards, bins, email templates, job codes and templates, locations, segment and EXCO values, career portal and LinkedIn posting settings, and offer and agreement templates. Manage user access, provisioning, and permissions, and maintain the iCIMS change tracker. Triage system and performance issues, open and follow vendor cases, and test configuration changes and releases before production. Run recurring controls covering requisition validation, pay-transparency and job-description compliance, background-check setup, approval exceptions, closeouts, source and agency data, and duplicate profiles. Manage GDPR actions and personal data requests in iCIMS in partnership with the Privacy team. Plan and execute data cleanup and bulk-update projects. Agency Administration, Training, and Knowledge: Administer the global preferred agency program: coordinate agreements with Legal, onboard and offboard agencies, manage system access, and keep contract records current. Maintain the TA Resource Library, SharePoint sites, approval matrix, process documentation, and training materials; train recruiters and regional HR contacts on iCIMS, new tools, and global TA processes. Hiring Processing and Recruiting Support: Process ready-to-hire hires where the hiring manager has identified the candidate: validate the requisition and approvals, create and move candidate records, prepare and route offers, initiate background checks, and hand off cleanly to HR Operations and Oracle HCM. Back up the TA and Early Careers recruiting teams during absences or volume spikes by keeping candidates moving, coordinating with hiring managers, and processing offers. Support internal mobility, rehire, transfer, and acquisition-related hiring processes. Qualifications: To land this role you will need : Experience implementing recruiting tools such as interviewing, assessment, or scheduling platforms, and integrating them with an ATS. Familiarity with laws and frameworks governing AI in hiring, such as bias audits and candidate-notice requirements. Exposure to HCM systems; experience in financial services or another regulated industry preferred. Recruiting coordination or recruiting support experience. • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Work arrangement: 4 days in office required.
